phase1.code:
# Project: Deployment

print("=== Project: Deployment ===\n")

print("""
Deployment puts your model into production.

Options:
  1. Local deployment
  2. Cloud deployment
  3. Container deployment (Docker)
  4. Serverless deployment
""")

print("=== Local Deployment ===\n")

print("""
# Run Flask app locally
python app.py

# Test API
curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/predict \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"features": [50, 100, 30, 20, 500, 10]}'
""")

print("\n=== Docker Deployment ===\n")

print("""
# Dockerfile
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

EXPOSE 5000

CMD ["python", "app.py"]

# Build image
docker build -t player-churn-model .

# Run container
docker run -p 5000:5000 player-churn-model
""")

print("\n=== Cloud Deployment ===\n")

print("""
# AWS Elastic Beanstalk
# 1. Create application
# 2. Upload code
# 3. Deploy

# Google Cloud Run
# 1. Build container
# 2. Push to Container Registry
# 3. Deploy to Cloud Run

# Heroku
# 1. Create app
# 2. Push to git
# 3. Deploy
""")

print("\n=== Serverless Deployment ===\n")

print("""
# AWS Lambda + API Gateway
# 1. Package model with code
# 2. Create Lambda function
# 3. Create API Gateway
# 4. Deploy
""")

print("\n=== Deployment Checklist ===\n")

print("""
✅ Model saved
✅ API built
✅ Dependencies listed
✅ Environment configured
✅ Health check implemented
✅ Error handling in place
✅ Monitoring set up
✅ Documentation complete
""")
